## Continuous saved-model gallery in Windows 0.24.32

Saved Models appends the next 20 entries when the end of the gallery approaches the viewport. Scrolling back returns to the existing tiles. The selected model and its export bar remain available while browsing. The gallery renders nearby thumbnails and releases distant images from their tiles, retaining up to 64 small previews in memory.

The list reads older records using the last model’s save time and ID. Equal timestamps have a deterministic order and a newer save does not shift the next batch. Loading stops at the last record. A failed batch offers a retry in place.

## Continuous saved-model gallery, Windows 0.24.32

The packaged Windows test started with an empty gallery and then browsed 47 models in an isolated library. Scrolling produced 20, 40, 47 tiles in sequence. A newer model was saved after the initial fetch and 40 of the original models shared a timestamp. The exact ordered IDs matched the original library, including across both batch boundaries. The test confirmed the original first tile remained mounted, the selected owl remained selected, its exported checksum matched, and returning to its tile restored its thumbnail. The new save appeared on reopening the gallery. Checked a narrow desktop layout and the absence of the paging and scene-editor buttons.
